status: ACTIVE. The land-cover base is the mined Bethesda GRAS binding; the region layer above it is decision 0048; the distance, clump and ground-colour fields are 16f.

grounding.schema: docs/research/placement-settlements/shipped-world-placement-rules.md R10: GRAS carries density, slope limits, a distance-from-water rule with a mode enum, position jitter, height/colour variance and a wind wave period; LTEX.GNAM binds grasses to painted ground and never allows more than three
grounding.landCoverIds: tooling/world-generation/worldgen/landcover.py, holding the same ids that the ground-control raster stores in its red channel
grounding.regionClasses: tooling/world-generation/worldgen/regions.py, holding the same ids that apps/world-studio/public/province/hydro-regions.png stores by colour
grounding.why: v1 was keyed by land cover alone, so the tidal delta, the interior swamp and the mangrove coast got identical grass wherever they shared a cover id. Round 13 spread the ring over 34 meshes. 16f fixed what was left. Sixteen covers carried no species, so a mountain, a mudflat and a beach were bare ground with a few weeds standing on it; the kit's variety was texture-only, five groups of identical geometry reading as one plant; every species faded at the same distance in an even mix. The kit is now 62 meshes chosen for silhouette. Six covers are bare. Each species carries its own height, fade distance and clump field.
grounding.richCoverTotals: the rich covers are authored at 2.2 times the pre-round-13 totals rather than at the totals themselves. Measured at those totals the ring put the jungle floor at 52% coverage and the rootland at 51%, both under the floors in worldgen/test_groundcover_floors.py. At 2.2 times they measure 63% and 65%, which is 16 to 19 thousand instances in a 75 m ring against a cap of 60 thousand. The multiplier is a measured number, so it is recorded with the table rather than in a commit message.

rules.maxSpeciesPerCoverNote: three is the cap on species that can stand at the same point, not on the length of a cover's list. The river bed and the seabed carry two lists, a wet one for the water that covers them and a dry one for the ground that the water has left. A point is inside one regime or the other, so neither list passes three
rules.resolution: species for (region class, land cover) = byRegionClass[region].swaps[cover] when present, else byLandCover[cover].species. A swap replaces the base list for that one cover in that one region; it never merges
rules.whyTheCapStillHolds: LTEX.GNAM's limit of three is per painted texture, so it caps how many species may share one cover. It does not constrain the same cover carrying different species in different regions. The swap layer therefore fits inside the shipped-game rule rather than bending it
rules.bareGroundIsFine: six covers carry no species at all: the roads and tracks, the paint under them, cliff faces, the salt pans and the wettest black mud. Open mud between the clumps is what gives a reed bed its edge. Every other cover carries at least two species, because a single species on a cover shows as one plant repeated across it
rules.tier: T3, regenerated at runtime from the land-cover raster inside a camera ring, never written into chunk bundles (module 65 §110)
rules.densityUnit: instances per hectare inside the ring, before the slope response and before the per-species distance thinning
rules.heightM: the asset's own vertical size in the built kit manifest, copied here so the ring can sort species into near and far without loading the kit first
rules.fadeM: the distance at which this species has thinned to nothing. Anything under 0.6 m tall is gone by 50 m, since a 30 cm tuft covers about a pixel at that range and still costs a draw. Taller species run to the ring radius. This is Bethesda's fade band and Unreal's per-variety cull distance, set per species rather than one radius for all
rules.waterRule: below-at-least puts a species in the water; above puts it on ground that the water has left, at a depth of 2 cm or less. A rule with neither is ordinary land cover. It tolerates the shallow standing water of a marsh to a depth of half a metre
rules.maxDepthM: how deep a below-at-least species will stand. 1.5 m for the marsh species that wade; 4 m for the three bed covers, which are the river bed, the seabed and the ocean floor
rules.clumpWavelengthM: wavelength of the per-species value-noise field that decides which of a cover's two or three species dominates where. Without it a three-species cover is an even mix everywhere and reads as one texture. At 12 m the species trade dominance in patches that a walking player crosses every few seconds
rules.colourVariance: how far each instance's colour may drift from the ground tint underneath it. The ring takes its colour from ground-tint.png, the Witcher 3 pigment-map trick, so grass roots match the ground in which they stand rather than floating as a separate green
rules.assetPool: every asset here must be in tooling/asset-pipeline/pipeline/config/kits/groundcover-province-v1.json, the one GLB that the ring loads. Adding a species is a kit rebuild, not a data edit. The kit carries 62 meshes. The triangle ceiling is 128, the highest count among the seven shipped assets. Every addition carries a silhouette that no other asset in the kit already has

bare.why: roads, tracks, cliff faces, salt pans and the wettest black mud carry no groundcover. Every other painted cover carries at least two species. The river bed, the seabed and the ocean floor left this list in 16f. The vanilla mine shows that Skyrim's kelp and coral are painted-ground grass records like any other, so the ring places them rather than the scatter compiler. The broken lowland rock left the list as well, being steep dirt-cliff ground rather than a cliff face. A bare mountainside was most of what made the uplands read as a quarry

regionCoversNote: land covers each region class actually paints, measured from the shipped apps/world-studio/public/province/refined/ground-control.png against hydro-regions.png (covers holding >=0.5% of the class's area and not in bare.covers, re-measured 2026-09-16 after the bare list shrank to six). A swap for a cover that a region does not paint is dead data; the breadth gate reads this list, not the whole cover table.
